title: Cinemov - Anshu
description: A cinematic camera mod that adds smooth camera movement, automatic angle switching, multiple perspectives, and creator-friendly controls for stunning Minecraft shots.
body:
# CineMov

CineMov is a lightweight cinematic camera mod designed for Minecraft content creators, cinematics makers, and players who want smooth camera movement without losing control of their character.

Unlike traditional AFK cinematic mods, CineMov allows you to keep moving, building, exploring, and playing while enjoying smooth cinematic camera effects.

## Features

🎥 Smooth Cinematic Camera

🔄 Automatic Camera Angle Switching

🎮 Full Player Control While Recording

👀 Multiple Camera Perspectives

⚡ Toggle with Keybinds

💻 Lightweight & Performance Friendly

🎬 Perfect for Replays, Trailers, Shorts, and Cinematics

## Controls

* F8 → Toggle CineMov
* F7 → Change Camera Angle
* F9 → Toggle Automatic Camera Rotation

## Commands

* /cinemov on
* /cinemov off
* /cinemov toggle
* /cinemov angle
* /cinemov auto

## Supported Version

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader

## Created By

**ItzAnshuu6**

Make your Minecraft recordings look smoother, more professional, and more cinematic with CineMov.
